The '''1960–61 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 25th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 17 September 1960 and ended on 2 July 1961 with the play-off match. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their second consecutive and fifth Greek title.

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
